camera.part: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 NoIR Wide
camera.pcb_local_axes: u along 25 mm edge, v along 24 mm edge, n normal from PCB rear towards lens

mask_guide.qualification: 8 x 8 square seed is the older project allowance around the modeled cylinder. Physical pupil, field projection, focus/mode dependency and corner rays are unknown.

tof.pcb_local_axes: untransformed STEP x/y in PCB plane, +z towards scene; H along STEP y, V along STEP x (widths)

mask_guide.projection: shared rectangular pyramid from padded package top, independent H/V slopes
mask_guide.qualification: Rounded-package STEP vertices cross-checked against the historical padded reserve. Separate TX/RX apertures, TX spread, RX angular response, corner rays and mask reflections remain unverified.

planes.d_definition: Axial distance ahead of the selected local optical reference plane. Table uses mechanical model references. For actual optics use each pupil or emitting/receiving reference separately.
planes.d_for_true_aperture_when_s_is_mechanical: d = s + z_ref - z_opt at back, plus t at front; local coordinates along the optical direction. Evaluate plane ahead of each effective origin.
planes.local_interval: [L - d*k_minus - m_minus, U + d*k_plus + m_plus] per transverse axis. Union the TX and RX intervals independently at each plane when measured separately.
planes.m_definition: Extra per-edge fabrication and registration allowance. Sample includes seed allowances only.
planes.wall: Flare through the material to contain all intermediate sections. For a straight cut use the outer section for the whole thickness. On a sloped or curved mask check the opening where the local ray envelope actually crosses the wall.
